step_2_decision_body:
## Owner Decision — Admit Task #32 Step 2: prepare a controlled ChatGPT bootstrap experiment

Following the Step 1 research in [PR #33](https://github.com/jresearchsoftware/shared-governance/pull/33) at exact head `bae27d667e953e9d4fa0da17cdc51860d13efbf4` and the [independent non-approving assessment](https://github.com/jresearchsoftware/shared-governance/pull/33#pullrequestreview-5521478376), the owner agrees to **test the minimal direct-GitHub bootstrap direction in practice before deciding on the architecture**. The research is sufficient to motivate this bounded experiment; that does **not** formally approve/merge PR #33, adopt a package topic or select a production solution.

**Admit one manual Codex execution: Step 2 — Prepare a controlled ChatGPT bootstrap experiment.** Independently accepted source-main/start binding for this execution is `15e8191435a126e54b4d1739a73fab112e01c081`, which remains separate from the unaccepted Step 1 candidate. Verify its currentness/acceptance before changing the branch; if source-main has advanced or authority is inconsistent, stop for reconciliation rather than silently rebasing onto a new authority. Read the complete current Task chronology, accepted AGENTS/manual Task Handoff and the Step 1 report, semantic map and independent assessment as **research evidence, not newly adopted policy**.

### Step 2 deliverables

1. Prepare the **smallest reusable static bootstrap prototype** with a clear Shared Governance-specific binding/overlay and a full ready-to-paste experimental Project Instructions text. Route at substantive task boundaries through the actual supported GitHub connector to accepted repository guidance, explicitly adopted VibeVM materialization and relevant live Task/PR/diff/CI evidence. Do not replace project-owned permissions, topic adoption or acceptance provenance with a moving link or copied candidate rules.
2. Prepare a reproducible, **one-action-at-a-time owner-facing setup and trial runbook**. The owner, not Codex, will later create/configure any temporary ChatGPT test projects. Compare a clean control with the experimental bootstrap, while keeping model/tool access and other context comparable; avoid hidden prior-chat/project memory bias where supported.
3. Prepare bounded **read-only behavioral cases**: routine discussion, Issue with body/comments/Decisions, a Codex Outcome link requiring independent substantive exact-head review, PR #27/#31 negative cases (Outcome/green checks alone must never justify positive review), adequate positive review with primary source/diff/check/warning evidence, stale/missing source and unsupported GitHub-access boundaries. Preserve Relay-v4 versus DocReview-v3/legacy and specialist permissions as distinct example bindings; do not activate either consumer. Favor small representative tests over a large new suite.
4. Define observable success/failure and an evidence capture sheet: distinguish actual connector/file/CI reads and correctness of decision from polished prose; include unqualified, partial and failed outcomes. Clearly separate local text/test validation from **future real ChatGPT model observations** and state what would or would not justify adopting the design.
5. Make the candidate and verification artifacts reviewable in this repository (ideally separately under `docs/task-32/step-2/`), with proportionate local checks and applicable exact-head CI. Reuse rather than duplicate the Step 1 research inventory.

### Authorization and stop boundary

This Step authorizes **repository-local experimental bootstrap and trial preparation only**. It does **not** authorize creation or modification of live ChatGPT projects/settings/Sources, external consumer repository edits, package release/publication, merging PR #33, changing accepted shared topics, production/credential access, approving this Deliberative result or closing Task #32. A generator, Skill, synchronized service or extra mandatory review/preflight control is **not** preselected or required; research alternatives remain open.

Publish the one canonical attributable English terminal Outcome according to the accepted manual Task Handoff, bound to exact result SHA(s), substantive evidence, CI, warnings and unqualified real-client cases. Stop for independent substantive **non-approving Deliberative review** and the owner's next Decision before any practical settings application, formal positive acceptance, merge or follow-on launch. **Task #32 stays OPEN.**
